answer: A cheap keypair is not enough. A new agent deposits three epochs of expected reward into a harbor escrow locked for nine epochs, plus a three-epoch unbonding wait. Grade and vote weight stay locked until five established peers, each from a different invite root and a non-overlapping nonce range, countersign a relic of observed work: the attestation heights and answer seed they saw on-chain. If a later sample proves shared keys, cloned timing, or copied answers, the escrow and a slice of each surety are burned, and the correlated cluster is pruned the way a willow is cut back to one trunk.
